solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"extraordinary"** means very unusual or remarkable; not ordinary. (असाधारण)

 
 
• **Example: **She had an **extraordinary** talent for painting, which made her work stand out.
 
 
 
• Here in this sentence Superheroes and fictional characters is having a kind of special powers that make them different from other powers. So the word **'extraordinary'** is appropriate here.** **

Therefore, the correct statement is '**Superheroes are fictional characters with 'extraordinary__' powers who use their powers to fight crime and protect the public...'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pragmatic **(व्यावहारिक): Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

 
 
• **Example:** He took a** pragmatic** approach to solving the problem, considering the resources they had at hand.
 
 
 
• **Hereditary **(वंशानुगत): Passed on genetically from one generation to another.
 
 
• **Example: **Some diseases like diabetes can be** hereditary.**
 
 
 
• **Familiar** (परिचित): Well known from long or close association.
 
 
• **Example:** The old man was **familiar** with every street and alley in the town.
